development_only_input.use: candidate selection only; development numbers are not promotion evidence

candidate_policy.name: R3-SH
candidate_policy.kind: public-information Scepter/Hullbreaker/Humility timing and color-reservation overlay
rules: Treat Isochron Scepter activation and Hullbreaker Horror trigger as distinct stack objects with distinct answer maps.
Removing Scepter after activation does not erase the current activation; Tidebinder directly counters that activation only when its ETB exists.
Under Humility, Tidebinder's ETB is suppressed while Hope-Ender Coatl's cast trigger remains live against a spell or spell copy.
Countering the spell that created a Hullbreaker trigger, or removing Hullbreaker afterward, does not erase that already-created trigger.
A live Tidebinder can counter one Hullbreaker trigger and blank Hullbreaker only while Tidebinder remains.
Preserve full Temur colors when a public Humility/Scepter state makes Beast Within or Chaos Warp materially different from blue-only interaction.

invariants: Scepter and Hullbreaker use distinct resolvers
source removal does not erase an already-stacked Scepter activation
countering a Hullbreaker trigger-source spell does not erase the trigger
Humility suppresses Tidebinder ETB but not Hope-Ender cast trigger
Tidebinder lifecycle is tracked separately from current-trigger countering
full Temur reservation is represented separately from blue-only interaction

promotion_scope.if_pass: promote R3-SH as Race public-state timing/color-reservation overlay only
promotion_scope.if_fail: reject R3-SH and return to development
